title: Spectral Leakage and Repeated Bernstein-Vazirani Key Recovery under Deterministic, Input-Dependent Noise (control-stage software)
description: Exact Walsh-spectrum analysis and finite control experiments for Bernstein-Vazirani key recovery against deterministic, input-dependent noise under an idealised Q2 phase oracle. The published deterministic-LPN construction experiment is pending; no security claim about real schemes is made.
